text:
laura: Heads-up: opened PR with a focused migration appendix for structured output + tiny SDK examples (https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1357). Looking for quick sanity checks on schema wording and the streaming fallback snippet.
ci-bot: preview build queued :hourglass_flowing_sand: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1357
alex: Skimming. In the SDK sample you reference `resp.schema` in one place and `resp.output_schema` in another. Recommend unifying to `resp.schema` to match SDK surface.
laura: Good catch, will standardize to `resp.schema`. Also added a short note titled "When to prefer compact schema" per product ask.
sameer: On nullable arrays: runtime and parsers differ; use `items.anyOf` not `items.type: ["string","null"]` to avoid edge-case coercion. Example I suggest: ```json
{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}]}}
```
maria: UX nit: add a one-line streaming fallback after the example so readers know how to handle chunked outputs. Small snippet: ```js
const r = await client.call(...);
if (r.stream) for await (const c of r.stream) processChunk(c);
```
laura: Thanks — pushing fixes now (schema name + nullable example + streaming note). Any link breaks I should watch for?
alex: Found one: the PR links to /docs/function-call but canonical route is /docs/tool-calling. Also examples/invoke-compact.md is referenced as invoke-compact-example.md in one spot.
laura: Will correct both. If no more flags I'll merge after CI passes.
ci-bot: preview ready :white_check_mark: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1357?v=2
sameer: pushed a tiny update to the nullable-array paragraph explaining downstream parser behavior. No ML blockers.
maria: LGTM from docs side.
laura: Merging in ~5m unless someone objects. Thanks for the quick reviews!
